Urk-Tar

The orc chief and two young warriors left to hunt long ago and have not returned. Find them; they have probably run into trouble.

Objectives

Find the orc party

Drive away the harpy

Kill the bats

Escort the chief to the fortress

Urk-Tar must survive

Locations

Maps
Distant Mountains
